reference_prolog:
/* ---------- Case facts ---------- */

father_since(charlie, bob, date(1995, 4, 15)).
mother(dorothy, bob).

married_on(alice, charlie, date(2018, 8, 8)).

/* ---------- Derived factual predicates ---------- */

father(Father, Child) :-
    father_since(Father, Child, _).

spouse(Person1, Person2) :-
    married_on(Person1, Person2, _).
spouse(Person1, Person2) :-
    married_on(Person2, Person1, _).

parent(Parent, Child) :-
    father(Parent, Child).
parent(Parent, Child) :-
    mother(Parent, Child).

ancestor(Ancestor, Descendant) :-
    parent(Ancestor, Descendant).
ancestor(Ancestor, Descendant) :-
    parent(Parent, Descendant),
    ancestor(Ancestor, Parent).

/* ---------- Section 152(d)(2)(C) ---------- */
/*
   A person bears the relationship described in section 152(d)(2)(C)
   to a taxpayer if that person is:
     - the taxpayer's father,
     - the taxpayer's mother, or
     - an ancestor of the taxpayer's father or mother.
*/

relationship_152d2c(Person, Taxpayer) :-
    father(Person, Taxpayer).
relationship_152d2c(Person, Taxpayer) :-
    mother(Person, Taxpayer).
relationship_152d2c(Person, Taxpayer) :-
    father(Father, Taxpayer),
    ancestor(Person, Father).
relationship_152d2c(Person, Taxpayer) :-
    mother(Mother, Taxpayer),
    ancestor(Person, Mother).

/* ---------- Query ---------- */

:- ( relationship_152d2c(alice, bob) -> format('Result: Entailment~n') ; format('Result: Contradiction~n') ).
:- halt.

expected.question: Alice bears a relationship to Bob under section 152(d)(2)(C).
